description: Base tunable physics constants for ball flight, swing, spin, and collision. Pitch/ground modifiers multiply against these. Values below are starting placeholders for prototyping (Milestone 1), not final-tuned.
notes: All values here are prototyping placeholders — expect heavy iteration during Milestone 1 (physics prototype) based on playtesting feel, not just real-world physical accuracy.
pitch_schema.json and ground_schema.json modifiers apply multiplicatively to these base values, not as replacements.
timing_window_good_ms / timing_window_early_late_ms feed directly into the batting input system (GDD.md control scheme) and the animation blend parameters (animation_requirements.md).
